title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional student hubs and quiet retreats across Brooklyn College's Georgian-style campus, from specialized media labs to tranquil garden spaces.

cards.title: Late-Night Study at Whitehead Hall
cards.subtitle: Whitehead Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Access 80 workstations and lounge seating in this dedicated computing facility. It offers full printing and scanning services and stays open later than the main library stacks.
cards.short_summary: A high-capacity computing and study lounge located in Whitehead Hall with extended hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library Café is located on the first floor of Whitehead Hall and has 80 workstations, lounge seating, and coffee services.
cards.source_title: Library Café - BC Knowledge for Students
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 9am-8:30pm and Friday 9:30am-6pm during standard terms.

cards.title: Tranquil Retreat by the Library
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to the Library
cards.notes: Visit this scenic campus landmark to see resident turtles and koi. It serves as a quiet outdoor sanctuary for students to relax or study between classes.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful outdoor garden and pond home to turtles and koi fish near the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lily Pond is a sanctuary for students to study or relax and is home to a micro-ecosystem of turtles and koi.
cards.source_title: What the Campus Has to Offer | Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public campus space accessible during college operating hours.

cards.title: Unwind with Free Pool and Foosball
cards.subtitle: Student Center, First Floor
cards.notes: Head to the first floor for a laid-back environment featuring free pool tables and foosball. The basement level also offers ping pong for student recreation.
cards.short_summary: A recreational hub in the Student Center offering free billiards and tabletop games.
cards.evidence_claim: The Game Room on the first floor of the Student Center offers free pool games and foosball for students.

cards.title: The Quietest Tables on Campus
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall, Top Floor
cards.notes: Find secluded study tables and chairs at the ends of the corridors on the fifth floor. This area is known among students for being exceptionally quiet and often vacant.
cards.short_summary: A lesser-known quiet study area located in the top-floor corridors of Boylan Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The 5th floor of Boylan Hall features vacant seats and medium-size square tables at the end of each corridor that are very quiet.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via stairs or elevator during Boylan Hall building hours.

cards.title: Student-Run Airwaves at Whitehead
cards.subtitle: Whitehead Hall, Room 306A
cards.notes: Visit the heart of student media where volunteers run a 24/7 free-form radio station. They host open hours for students interested in broadcasting and podcasting.
cards.short_summary: The campus radio station in Whitehead Hall where students produce and stream original content.
cards.evidence_claim: WBCR is a free-form, student-run radio station located in Room 306A of Whitehead Hall.
cards.access_notes: Open hours typically held Monday-Thursday in the afternoons.

cards.title: Low-Traffic Tech Hub
cards.subtitle: Student Center, First Floor
cards.notes: Utilize this computer lab for quick assignments; it is known for having less foot traffic than the main library labs while maintaining the same high-speed bandwidth.
cards.short_summary: A quieter alternative computer lab located on the first floor of the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Computer Corner has less traffic than other labs on campus with the same bandwidth.

cards.title: Workout at the West Quad
cards.subtitle: West Quad Center, Room 123
cards.notes: Access modern exercise equipment and recreational facilities. This center is the primary spot for students to maintain fitness between academic sessions.
cards.short_summary: The main student fitness and recreation facility located in the West Quad Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Quad Fitness Center offers independent exercise and general fitness for students in Room 123.
cards.source_title: West Quad Fitness Center - Brooklyn College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Valid Brooklyn College ID required for entry; hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Deep Focus in the Stacks
cards.subtitle: Library, Multiple Floors
cards.notes: Find designated silent zones throughout the library for distraction-free work. These areas are strictly monitored to ensure a quiet environment for intense study.
cards.short_summary: Designated quiet zones within the main library for students requiring total silence.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brooklyn College Library offers designated silent study spaces and quiet conversation spaces for students.
cards.access_notes: Available during regular library operating hours.

cards.title: Social Hub at BK Campus Eats
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall, Basement Level
cards.notes: Gather at the campus's primary dining hall, which features diverse global cuisine stations and a coffee shop. It serves as a major social crossroads for the student body.
cards.short_summary: The central campus dining facility and social gathering spot located in Boylan Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boylan Hall cafeteria, operated by BK Campus Eats, is a hub where students dine and socialize.
cards.source_title: BK Campus Eats: Boylan Hall Cafeteria
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 8am-7pm and Friday 9am-4pm during classes.

cards.title: Quiet Corner in the SU
cards.subtitle: Student Center, Fifth Floor
cards.notes: Escape the noise of the lower levels by heading to the fifth-floor study room. It provides a dedicated quiet space within the otherwise bustling Student Center.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet study room located on the upper floor of the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: If you desire quiet time to study, visit our Study Room on the fifth floor of the Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center operating hours, typically until 9pm Monday-Thursday.
